items.title: [2026-07-12] Your phone is your shopfront (Image Prompt)
items.content: SCENE: A confident young Indian shop owner standing in a sunlit local marketplace, holding up a smartphone toward the camera like a storefront sign. SUBJECT: warm, aspirational, everyday-entrepreneur energy; genuine smile; casual modern Indian attire. PHONE-UI MOCKUP: on the phone screen, a clean QckServe listing card — product photo, a bold 'Rs.0 to list' pill, a 'Message owner' button, no price-commission text; crisp app UI, rounded 14px corners. COLOUR SYSTEM: flat colour blocking, NO gradients — orange #ef6723 dominant field, deep charcoal #1A1A1A panels, off-white #FCF9F8 highlights, single accent #FF6B00. LIGHTING: bright natural midday light, soft directional fill, gentle shadow under the phone. TYPE HIERARCHY: one oversized condensed headline 'YOUR PHONE IS YOUR SHOPFRONT' upper area, small italic-serif kicker 'a small manifesto', tiny 'qckserve.in' lockup. EYE FLOW: face -> raised phone screen -> headline -> qckserve.in. CAMERA: 35mm, eye-level, shallow depth of field, subject sharp, market softly blurred. PERFORMANCE LAYER: high thumb-stopping contrast, mobile-first legibility, poster-grade clarity. RESERVE the TOP-LEFT square logo zone empty (logo placed manually). --ar 4:5 --style raw --v 6.1
